## Before submitting

Discuss the change in an issue and agree on the approach before opening a pull
request. Please do not invest time in an unsolicited implementation and assume
it will be merged.

MyNovelBuilder is a passion project built first and foremost around my own
writing workflow, preferences, and creative direction. I review pull requests
for fit with the project's direction, scope, user experience, and ongoing
maintenance burden. A working implementation is not automatically a change I
want to maintain, and acceptance is not guaranteed.
